title: The Cloud Decision That Regulated Banks Keep Getting Wrong
description: Cloud migration in regulated banking is consistently framed as a technology selection problem. The question that actually determines whether migration delivers value is organizational: who owns the cloud estate, and how does accountability change when the infrastructure moves?

title: Beyond Redundancy: Why Platform Resilience Is an Organizational Discipline, Not a Technical Specification
description: Platform resilience is not a property you design into a system once — it's an organizational discipline you maintain continuously. A perspective on what resilience architecture actually delivers.

title: Beyond the SLA: Why Design Authority Is the Real Governance Question in Managed Services
description: The service level agreement is not the governance instrument that most determines whether a managed services engagement delivers value. The question that matters more is: where does design authority sit?

title: The Contract Before the Code: Why Specification Alignment Is the Hidden Work of Payment Modernisation
description: The hidden work of IPS payment modernisation — why specification misalignment between parties is found at design time in successful programs and at go-live in failed ones.

title: Running Sixteen Domains in Parallel: Why Structure Is the Prerequisite to Speed
description: How to run fifteen or sixteen integration workstreams simultaneously without the program collapsing under coordination overhead. Structure before speed.

title: The Portfolio Before the Platform: Why Enterprise Integration Starts With Knowing What You Have
description: The most common failure mode in enterprise integration modernization is not technical risk or vendor selection — it's incomplete inventory. The map is not the territory, but without a map, you have no territory at all.

title: Architecture Is Not a Plan: How Integration Programs Get Stuck Between Strategy and Delivery
description: A roadmap tells you where you're going. A work package tells you who is doing what, by when, at what cost. Only one creates accountability. The discipline that closes the gap between strategy and delivery.

title: Why Most Digital Transformations Fail—and It's Not the Technology
description: The pattern is always the same. Leadership buys a platform. The technology is deployed. And then nothing changes. Technology doesn't transform organizations. Operating model changes do.

title: The Platform Mindset: Why Banks Need to Stop Building Projects and Start Building Capabilities
description: Every bank has the same problem. Projects end, platforms compound. Why organizational design — not technology — is the difference between project-driven and platform-driven.

title: Open Banking in KSA: Compliance Checkbox or Strategic Opportunity?
description: SAMA's Open Banking framework is the most significant regulatory shift in Saudi banking since SARIE. Most banks are treating it as compliance. That's a mistake.

title: The Integration Leader's Real Job: Building the Organization, Not Just the Architecture
description: Architecture doesn't survive contact with a bad organization. After 14 years, the lesson: the architecture and the organization are inseparable. Conway's Law isn't a joke — it's a design constraint.

title: Governance That Accelerates: The Counterintuitive Truth About Enterprise Standards
description: The best governance makes the right thing the easy thing. Not a gate — a ramp. How enterprise integration governance at SAIB was embedded in the platform rather than the process.

title: AI Without Infrastructure: Why Most Banking AI Projects Are Set Up to Fail
description: Every bank in KSA is running an AI initiative. So is the disappointment rate. The pattern: not because the model was wrong, but because the data wasn't there. Integration architecture is the real AI product.
